stage: A + B + C3 (Баатар) + C3b (all 5 classes, mastery, smith, farming factor, 6 weapon tiers)

classArmor.note: all 5 classes: 4 pieces × 6 tiers each (120 definitions, 30 sets), soulbound, budget fitted to the simulator's generic proxy; granted and worn at class pick and on join; regenerated in place; recover; kept on death; SoulboundGuard

armorLevel.note: armour XP from validated active minutes (0.6), kills 0.2/1/3, quest 20, discovery 15, dungeon clear 25 × repeat fatigue; capped at the player level, ×2 catch-up; live-tested. The desk XP values still need measuring on humans (ACTIVE_PLAYTIME_SPEC). QUEST grants count as a chapter (daily tasks too) and every DISCOVERY as a region (landmarks are not told apart)

armorTier.note: gates: armour level, dungeon cleared, mastery rank (T3 1 / T4 3 / T5 5 / T6 7), coins, band materials, Ascension for T6. T2/T3 reachable with today's dungeons; T4–T6 dungeons and Ascension are not in the game. Bought at the Дархан smith (SmithMenu, confirmation step); the command is staff/debug only. Tier names renamed (no rarity collision)

armorMastery.evidence: api/classgear/MasteryRules, MasteryPerks; ClassArmor.addMastery/mobKilled/spellCast/objective; SkillTreeService.refreshRuntime; SkillService resource multipliers
armorMastery.note: activity-based sources with per-minute caps, gap rule, repeat fatigue, farming factor; rank milestones (level ≥ 6r, dungeons); perks at 3/6/9 (some (≈) substitutions documented); +0.25 %/rank power; sim C13 PASS (day-7 p90 rank 5)

armorSetBonuses.note: Баатар 2-piece max health / 4-piece damage reduction, growing per tier

armorVisuals.note: procedural 64×32 placeholder layers (helmet painted on the head layer); final art and 3D helmet models are Stage C4; MANUAL_QA_REQUIRED in a real client

activePlaytime.note: 1-minute windows, strong/two-family rule, soul exclusion, auto-clicker (>120 identical intervals ±10 ms), AFK mob farm (3rd minute of damage-in), away after 15 min, area fatigue (armour XP only), passive movement (rail, boat, glide, water current) excluded; per-category minutes in the profile (V13); feeds armour XP and wound healing. Live: 2 combat minutes counted, 2+ AFK minutes counted 0. Not done: yaw/pitch macro pattern, the EXP part of area fatigue (a balance change), session totals to analytics, the 'away' TAB marker

statPipeline.note: armour stats already flow into SkillBuild; reuse

persistence.note: round trip and refuse-to-load-broken-data verified on PostgreSQL; MySQL migration written, not run here

clientQa.note: worn look of the six tiers, tooltip, equip sounds

armorEnhancement.note: +2 % per step through the stat pipeline (items unchanged, so the validator stays exact); tempering not implemented

smithNpc.note: inspect pieces + weapon, current/next tier, every requirement with held/needed, mastery and perks, enhance; confirmation re-checks gates and distance to the smith (≤ 8 blocks). MANUAL_QA_REQUIRED in a real client

farmingFatigue.note: player EXP, armour XP and mastery from open-world kills; f(n)=max(0.25, 1/(1+(n-40)/60)) over 30 active minutes within 48 blocks; dungeons/events/bosses/quests untouched; docs/PROGRESSION_BALANCE_SPEC.md §4.x

classWeaponTiers.note: 6 tiers at 1/12/24/36/48/60, stored weapons stay valid; visuals MANUAL_QA_REQUIRED

spec.simulated: armour level/tier breakpoints simulated (docs/PROGRESSION_SIMULATION.md §Class armour): no hardcore run reaches AL60+T6 within 30 days; T6 ~day 90 at 10 h/day; AFK scenario stays at armour level 1
